$comment: Advisories that are known, judged, and deliberately not fixed yet.
`npm audit` has no allowlist, so the choice it leaves you is to fail on
everything or gate on nothing. Both are useless: a gate that cannot
express 'we looked at this one' gets switched off the first time it is
inconvenient, and then it stops catching the advisories that DO matter.
scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails on anything not listed here. Adding an entry
is a decision with a reason attached, not a way to make a run go green.
Never add one without reading the advisory and writing down why.

allowed.reason: Flagged only because it depends on the image-size above. Metro is the bundler; it runs on this machine and in CI, never on a device.
Flagged only because it pulls metro, and so image-size. A build-time CLI plugin, not shipped in the app.

Flagged only as the root of the metro chain above — the advisory is in image-size, not in React Native itself. Worth re-reading rather than assuming next time this appears: an entry on react-native is broad, and a real advisory against React Native proper would be hidden by it.
allowed.realFix: Expo 52 -> 57, which moves React Native too.

allowed.reason: Reached only through metro, the bundler, on two paths: expo -> expo-file-system -> expo@57 -> @expo/metro, and react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro. Metro reads image dimensions at bundle time from assets in this repository. It does not run on a device and never parses an image that came from a user or a network.
allowed.whyNotFixed: Both advisories are denial of service through infinite loops in the ICNS, JXL and HEIF parsers, reachable only by feeding the parser a malformed image. The only images it is fed are our own, committed to the repository. `npm audit fix --force` resolves it by moving metro itself, which is a bundler change on a project whose native build has already been broken once by a dependency bump made to satisfy an audit.
allowed.realFix: Expo 52 -> 57, the same migration that clears tar. Tracked separately.

allowed.reason: Reached only through @expo/cli, which declares tar ^6.2.1 and uses it to unpack the Expo project template at build time. It never runs on a user's device and never sees an archive from anywhere but the npm registry.
allowed.whyNotFixed: There is no patched 6.x. Forcing tar 7 through overrides was tried on 2026-08-06 and BROKE THE NATIVE BUILD: tar 7 sets __esModule without a default export, so @expo/cli's _interopRequireDefault yields undefined and prebuild dies with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'extract')". The audit went green while the app could no longer be built — a worse outcome than the advisory.
allowed.realFix: Expo 52 → 57, which ships a CLI that uses tar 7 correctly. Tracked separately; it is a five-major migration with a React Native upgrade underneath and is not an audit fix.

allowed.reason: Flagged only because it depends on the tar above. Same path, same reasoning.
Flagged only because it depends on cacache and tar above. Build-time CLI, not shipped.
Flagged only because it depends on @expo/cli above.

The root of the whole navigation group below. Denial of service by exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input. Reached through query-string -> @react-navigation/core, which parses the query part of a URL — including a deep link, and this app registers the `lume` scheme. **This one ships.** Unlike every entry above it, this code runs in the app on a user device, not only at build time — so the reasoning that covers the metro and @expo/cli chains does not cover it. Tracked as a finding in the audit ledger rather than only here.
allowed.whyNotFixed: It cannot be overridden. The advisory covers <=0.4.2, so the only fixed release is 0.5.0, and 0.5.0 is ESM-only ("type": "module", exports map, no CommonJS entry). query-string@7.1.3 is CommonJS and loads it with require(). Forcing 0.5.0 would not fail the audit, it would fail the bundle — which is the exact trade the note at the top of this file exists to refuse.
allowed.realFix: expo-router 4 -> 57, which drops query-string@7 for a version that does not depend on this package. Same migration as the Expo 52 -> 57 entries above.
